product.name: Circle
product.description: Circle is an iOS app for saving songs, films, books, links, and places, making thoughtful collections, and discovering through people whose taste you trust.
product.short_description: Save what shapes you. Discover through people whose taste you trust.

terms.name: Thing
terms.definition: A saved song, film, book, link, place, photo, note, or other media object.

terms.name: Save
terms.definition: The action for saving a thing or collection in Circle.

terms.name: Collection
terms.definition: A group of up to 30 things chosen around a place, trip, mood, idea, or person.

terms.name: Your circle
terms.definition: The people you follow in Circle.

claims.wording: Circle lets people save songs, films, books, links, and places.
People can make collections containing up to 30 things.
Circle is designed for discovery through people whose taste you trust.
